name: Musculoskeletal Modelling & Human Augmentation
summary: The biology side of exoskeletons and prosthetics: modelling the body, coupling devices to muscles and nerves, and measuring whether augmentation helps.

topics.name: Musculoskeletal simulation (OpenSim-style models) and muscle-driven simulations
EMG-driven models and estimating muscle forces
Metabolic cost estimation and human-in-the-loop optimisation
Exoskeleton biomechanics: assisting joints, torque profiles and user adaptation
Physical human-device interface: attachment, pressure, comfort and safety
Prosthetic limbs: sockets, osseointegration and powered prostheses
Targeted muscle reinnervation and neural control of prostheses
Sensory feedback, embodiment and the body schema
Human factors, fatigue and long-term effects of wearing augmentation
